items.title: 0.4.7 is out
items.text: The biggest Reborn update yet is out for everyone, and you are already on it. Stats, leaderboards and achievements, clan tags, a protected name, fairer teams, a bug report form, new controls and prompts, Discord status and a much lighter game.

items.title: Invisible players or black textures
items.text: Go to Settings, Graphics and choose Rebuild shaders. We are aware that some players can become invisible, or some textures can turn black, and it is being investigated. Rebuilding your shaders should fix it. If it does not, please be patient for the next hotfix.

items.title: Can't load into a server?
items.text: Turn off third party overlays such as RivaTuner, Overwolf and others, then try again. They can stop the game from joining a server.

items.title: Bots in the game?
items.text: Please check the FAQ in our Discord about bots being added to the game.

items.title: Hotfix 0.4.7.4 is out
items.text: A big map in the pause menu, queues for full servers, a Rebuild shaders option, a new achievement chime, sound fixes from the community and more. You are already on it.

items.title: The whole battle on one map
items.text: The pause menu now opens on a large map of the battle. LB and RB (Q and E) switch to the Field Report, and X zooms in on the island.

items.title: Queue for a full server
items.text: Join a full server and you get a place in its queue. Watch your position move up, and you join by yourself when your turn comes.

items.title: A chime from the theme
items.text: Achievements now ring with a sound made on your PC from the Battlefield theme in your own game files. And your name can now end with a trademark sign.

items.title: REDEPLOY and server labels
items.text: Suicide is now REDEPLOY in the pause menu. Our servers read REBORN OFFICIAL SERVER, and community servers we vouch for read TRUSTED COMMUNITY SERVER.

items.title: Better sound
items.text: Plane engines no longer drop out, the Effects volume now covers gunfire, and sounds are no longer cut short at their end.

items.title: Fresh shaders after updates
items.text: Every update now builds your saved shaders again in full. Smoother rendering, VSync that switches at once, Linux fixes and general bug fixes.

items.title: Thank you, DiXN and SmokeDoggy044
items.text: DiXN brought instant VSync, smoother rendering and Linux fixes. SmokeDoggy044 brought the sound fixes and Custom Match hosting on Linux.

items.title: Join us on Discord
items.text: Find a squad, see when the servers fill up and tell us what you find in the playtest.
